verdict.rationale: SumUp documents webhooks that send outbound notifications to a callback URL. Coverage is narrow: the docs state the system only notifies about checkout status changes, and you subscribe per checkout by passing a `return_url` when creating it, not by registering a general subscription. missing for 10: event types beyond checkout status changes, an account-level webhook registration/management API, payload signing/verification and retry documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: To subscribe to an event, specify a `return_url` parameter upon checkout creation.
At this time our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout.
